summary: Creates, renames, duplicates, deletes, and creates matrix attributes on POP point, vertex, primitive, or group data. It is the basic structured attribute-management operator for POP workflows.

key_params.name: attr0type
key_params.note: Numeric type for a new attribute

key_concepts: Creates new POP attributes with explicit numeric type, component count, array size, and default values.
Renames, duplicates, and deletes attributes within the selected point, vertex, or primitive attribute class.
Supports matrix attributes with explicit row and column counts for transform-style data.
Can isolate a branch by deleting input attributes after authoring only the attributes needed downstream.
common_gotchas: Attribute class must match where the data actually lives: point, vertex, primitive, or group.
Deleting input attributes can break render attributes such as P, N, Color, Tex, PointScale, or LineWidth.
Matrix attributes need explicit row and column counts.
